summary: Braskem S.A., a Brazilian petrochemical company, filed a Form 6-K with its bylaws (Estatuto Social) as a routine periodic report for June 2026. The filing restates the company's name, headquarters, purpose, capital structure—share capital of R$8.04 billion divided into 797 million shares (451.7M common, 345.5M preferred)—and governance provisions under Brazilian law and B3 Level 1 listing rules. No transaction, event, or special situation is disclosed; this is a standard corporate governance update. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or risk-arb angles to analyze. This is a non-special-situation filing.
